summary: Adversarial execution review of WI-556 final-SHA mandatory-skill coverage implementation identified two High-severity defects in scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs and scripts/check-chain-receipts.mjs: (1) malformed Git CLI argument syntax for '--force-with-lease' during CAS notes push causing retry exhaustion and spurious MERGED_UNVERIFIED exits, and (2) slot key phase stripping in merge finalization where exec-record receipts keyed with phase P3 are recorded with unphased receipt_slot values that fail child resolution in check-chain-receipts.mjs.

findings.claim: scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs passes malformed "-force-with-lease" argument to git push during CAS publish
findings.analysis: In scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs (line 2949), CAS push argument construction performs 'if (lease) pushArgs.push("-force-with-lease" + lease);'. Git command-line option parsing requires double-dash flags ('--force-with-lease=...') for long options. Passing '-force-with-lease<lease>' causes git push to error on unknown command switches whenever a lease ref exists, exhausting all 5 publish retries and aborting with finalizeFail('CAS publish exhausted retries') (exit code 3 MERGED_UNVERIFIED).
evidence: scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs:2947-2950: const lease = gitOut(["rev-parse", "refs/notes/svc-receipts-remote-view"]) || ""; const pushArgs = ["push", "origin", "refs/notes/svc-receipts:refs/notes/svc-receipts"]; if (lease) pushArgs.push("-force-with-lease" + lease); const pushRes = spawnSync("git", pushArgs, { cwd: root, encoding: "utf8" });
findings.proposed_fix: Update line 2949 in scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs to use valid Git force-with-lease syntax: if (lease) pushArgs.push(`--force-with-lease=refs/notes/svc-receipts:${lease}`);

findings.claim: Slot phase mismatch between merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs coverage compilation and check-chain-receipts.mjs child lookup
findings.analysis: In scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs (lines 2923-2926), child receipt lookup checks both unphased and phased slot keys (childBySlot.get(slot) || childBySlot.get(`${slot}::P3`)), but always sets entry.receipt_slot to the unphased slot string. In scripts/check-chain-receipts.mjs (lines 2530-2532), slotMap keys are indexed with candidate.phase (e.g. slot::exec-record::WI-556::<sha>::P3). During verifyCoverage, resolveChild(entry.receipt_slot) queries the unphased slot key and returns null because slotMap only contains the phased key. This causes verifyCoverage to fail with 'execute-changeset: child receipt slot missing' on final SHAs carrying phased exec-record receipts.
evidence: scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs:2923-2927: const slot = `slot::${entry.producer_receipt_type}::${wiMatch}::${oid}`; const child = childBySlot.get(slot) || childBySlot.get(`${slot}::P3`) || null; return { ...entry, receipt_slot: slot, ...(child ? { receipt_sha256: cov.sha256Hex(cov.stableStringify(child)) } : {}) };

scripts/check-chain-receipts.mjs:2530-2532: for (const candidate of normalized.entries) { slotMap.set(compositeSlotKey(candidate.receipt_type || candidate.type, candidate.wi ?? candidate.receipt?.wi ?? covWi, sha, candidate.phase ?? null), candidate.receipt); }

scripts/lib/skill-coverage.mjs:2814-2820: const slot = String(entry.receipt_slot || ""); const child = typeof resolveChild === "function" ? resolveChild(slot) : null; if (!child) { rows.push({ ...pickRowFields(entry), result: "MISSING", detail: `child slot not found in envelope` }); fail(`${entry.skill}: child receipt slot missing`); continue; }
findings.proposed_fix: In scripts/merge-pr-with-review-receipt.mjs, record the actual matched slot key in receipt_slot (e.g., const matchedSlot = childBySlot.has(slot) ? slot : (childBySlot.has(`${slot}::P3`) ? `${slot}::P3` : slot); return { ...entry, receipt_slot: matchedSlot, ... };) and/or update scripts/check-chain-receipts.mjs resolveChild fallback to query both slot and slot + '::P3'.
